description: Agent Research Lab Records: submit a research lab equipment record, the instrument inventory with its calibration and maintenance entries, with the work entries that rely on the instruments: the reading moment; each instrument the record lists with its id, reference (the instrument identifier) and name; each calibration entry with its id, reference, the instrument, the moment calibrated and the moment the next calibration is due; each maintenance or repair entry with its id, reference, the instrument, what was done and the moment done; each work entry with its id, reference, the instrument, the record showing the work and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the equipment and the records behind it, each instrument whose latest calibration has fallen due against a later calibration, each work entry against the calibration in force on its date, each maintenance or repair entry against the instruments the record lists, and each listed instrument against a calibration history, and counts them, and names divergent research lab equipment records: a calibration due with none recorded, work recorded on an instrument past its calibration date, a maintenance or repair entry for equipment the record does not list, and an instrument with no calibration history behind it; then a calibration or maintenance entry missing the instrument identifier or its date and an instrument listed twice, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No instruments, or no calibration entries beside listed instruments, leaves those points unverified. Instruments and entries match by letters and digits, so ICP-01 and ICP 01 are one instrument, dates by the day, a calibration is current through the day it falls due, and a calibration due after the reading moment waits. Calibration and maintenance are read inside this equipment record check; it calibrates, services and runs no instrument. Verdict researchlab_equipment_record_divergent, researchlab_equipment_record_partial, researchlab_equipment_record_unverified or researchlab_equipment_record_consistent. POST /api/researchlab-equipment-record-check. Reads the research lab records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it runs no test, accredits no laboratory, inspects no facility, contacts no regulator, accreditor or sponsor and issues no accreditation, certification or approval, which stay with the laboratory, its accreditor and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Research Lab Records reads the research laboratory as an organization, its facility, accreditation, equipment, safety, staff qualification, inspection, incident and operations paper, and never study-level data of any kind: clinical and patient lab records belong to Agent Healthcare, and a clinical or diagnostic laboratory’s records belong to Agent Healthcare even where the same building also does research; animal records belong to Agent Veterinary Records; consent records belong to Agent Consent; research data and datasets belong to Agent Datasets and Agent Evaluation; waste manifests belong to Agent Waste and Recycling Records; grant records belong to Agent Grants; forensic custody belongs to Agent Legal; the sampling-chain method belongs to Agent Water Records; and import, export and government contract records belong to Agent Customs Records and Agent GovCon. It reads no study record, subject record or result value, published or unpublished. The family’s ground is the laboratory’s operations paper trail: whether the facility record matches its accreditation, whether the equipment is in calibration, whether the staff file supports the work signed, and whether the safety, inspection, incident and operations records line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-research-lab-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-research-lab-records/.

calibrations.description: Each calibration entry in the equipment record.

due_at.description: When the next calibration is due, such as 2026-03-02.

instruments.description: Each instrument the equipment record lists.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

maintenance.description: Each maintenance or repair entry in the equipment record.

ref.description: The maintenance or repair entry reference.

work.description: Each entry recording work on an instrument.

at.description: When the work was recorded, such as 2026-03-02.
